```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_id]
  simp only [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_id]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_inj, Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_mul]
  rw [Nat.add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add]
  simp only [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  ring
```
